title: soft_verify: unguarded siglen cast for ECDSA variants
description: wp11_backend_soft.c soft_verify() casts siglen to word32 for ECDSA and ECDSA_SHA256 without WP11_FITS_U32 guard. EDDSA has the guard (lines 513-514) but ECDSA/ECDSA_SHA256 do not. A truncated siglen causes wc_ecc_verify_hash to read fewer signature bytes, potentially accepting an invalid signature as valid.
